name: anti-slop
description: Keeps what the agent makes from reading as AI slop, in two skills. anti-slop-ui covers interfaces: no gradient-everything, rainbow palettes, pulsing badges for states that never change, fingernail-striped cards, emoji icons, default fonts, uppercase labels, scroll effects, screens with no hierarchy or no empty, loading, and error states, or landing-page hype on working screens. anti-slop-text covers prose: no invented details, inflated significance, promotional tone, weasel attributions, not-X-but-Y contrasts, manufactured rhythm, AI vocabulary, chat residue, restating conclusions, or PR text about what was left unchanged. Each checks its output against a catalog of known tells before it ships.
